answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 816 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the tundra queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 146 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
